scheme_name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
other_conditions: Must be a Mizo student permanently residing in Mizoram.
Must be studying at Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun.
Must not be covered under any other scholarship scheme.
Scholarship is available for any class for only one year and renewable as per rules/conditions.
If the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the NDA, the scholarship will be discontinued from the date of such declaration.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance, free accommodation, food, and medical care to eligible Mizo cadets at RIMC.
